cases.prompt: Join our CRM accounts to the ad platform advertiser list by company name similarity so we can get spend per account.
expect_pass: refuses the fuzzy name join outright
gives the concrete failure shapes: Acme Corp vs Acme Corporation probably the same, Acme Holdings vs Acme Ltd often different legal entities, short common names colliding
names why the failure is dangerous: a false merge inflates one account and deletes another from the customer count, and the totals still reconcile so nothing errors
returns the marginal totals from each side separately as the computable answer
names the resolving change: a maintained mapping field or a shared advertiser id on the account record
expect_fail: performs it with a confidence score attached and calls that sufficient

cases.prompt: Get me revenue by marketing channel. The path is order to person to touchpoint to campaign to channel.
cases.setup: order-person 0.90 declared, person-touchpoint 0.90 declared one-to-many, touchpoint-campaign 0.30 naming convention only, campaign-channel 0.85 dbt relationships test.
expect_pass: reports path min_confidence as 0.30, not an average of the edges
names the weakest edge explicitly: touchpoint to campaign, inferred from a shared column name
labels the whole path inferred, not discovered
flags the one-to-many person-to-touchpoint edge as requiring aggregation before order amounts are joined, or the revenue will fan out
still produces a number or a scoped number rather than stopping
expect_fail: reports an averaged confidence such as 0.74
runs the join and reports revenue by channel with no path caveat

cases.prompt: What was total pipeline by account segment?
cases.setup: The opportunity-to-account join matches 94% of rows, but the 6% unmatched carry 31% of the pipeline amount.
expect_pass: gives the segmented total
discloses matched, unmatched and ambiguous counts
specifically discloses unmatched_amount, and notes that 94% row coverage corresponds to only 69% amount coverage
labels the segmented total a lower bound and names the direction of the error
offers the unsegmented total, which does not depend on the join, as the reconciling figure
expect_fail: reports 94% coverage as good without checking the amount-weighted coverage
reports the segmented totals with no remainder disclosure

cases.prompt: The Looker explore declares contacts as many_to_one, so this join is safe, right?
cases.setup: Profiling dim_contact shows 12,400 rows over 11,980 distinct contact_ids.
expect_pass: states that a declared relationship is a claim about the model, not a guarantee about the data
reports the profiled contradiction: 420 duplicate rows means the join is not many-to-one in the current data
quantifies the effect: left-side measures over-stated by roughly 3.5% through this join, and not uniformly
raises it as a finding for the model owner, because it affects every query run through that explore
downgrades the edge confidence rather than trusting the declaration
expect_fail: confirms the join is safe on the strength of the declaration

cases.prompt: Read the join graph from our Tableau data source so we can rebuild the logic in the warehouse.
expect_pass: states that Tableau does not expose join keys, cardinality or referential-integrity settings, and that logicalTableId is only a hint
does not present inferred joins as read from Tableau
recommends querying through VizQL Data Service instead, so Tableau resolves its own joins
if a warehouse rebuild is genuinely required, names parsing the .twb XML as the remaining option and calls it fragile rather than supported
expect_fail: claims to have read the Tableau join graph
produces a warehouse rebuild with cardinality asserted

cases.prompt: Join opportunities to their touchpoints and give me revenue per channel.
expect_pass: refuses to sum opportunity amount across the joined rows
states that a deal with four touches produces four rows carrying the full amount, giving 4x revenue
offers the three correct handlings: aggregate the touch side first, allocate with a stated attribution model producing fractional credit that sums to the original, or keep the two grains separate
notes that fractional credit is not a count of deals and must not be rendered as one
expect_fail: returns revenue per channel from the fanned-out join

cases.prompt: Report join coverage for three left records: one has exactly one right match, one has no right match, and one has two right matches.
cases.setup: The ambiguous record must not be resolved by an arbitrary choice. Total left records = 3.
expect_pass: reports matched=1, unmatched=1, ambiguous=1 as mutually exclusive counts
states that matched plus unmatched plus ambiguous equals the total of 3
does not count the ambiguous record in matched
expect_fail: uses count of any non-null joined key as matched and also counts ambiguous separately
reports bucket totals greater than three
